2014_spells.void-writing-egw.description: You can write on any surface, but the writing is visible only to creatures you specify. The writing appears on the surface as normal writing, but it is invisible to all other creatures. The writing lasts for the duration, but it can be ended early by you as a bonus action.
2014_spells.void-writing-egw.effectSumma: Make a creature invisible until it attacks or the spell ends
